# GitHub Instructions & Documentation Index

This directory contains specifications, milestones, implementation guides, and requirements for the War of Attrition game.

## 📄 Document Sitemap

- [`war-of-attrition-requirements.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/war-of-attrition-requirements.md) - Single source of truth for functional, UI/UX, non-functional, and EARS requirements.
- [`development-milestones.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/development-milestones.md) - Master roadmap detailing Milestones 1 through 7.
- [`milestone-7-implementation-plan.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/milestone-7-implementation-plan.md) - Action plan for final polish, PWA features, performance, and accessibility.
- [`implementation-guidelines.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/implementation-guidelines.md) - Code quality standards, Angular conventions, and architectural rules.
- [`current-development-status.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/current-development-status.md) - Status snapshot of completed features and active tasks.
- [`progress-data.json`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/progress-data.json) - Single source of truth JSON file for live progress tracking in the app UI.
- [`technical-analysis.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/technical-analysis.md) - Technical architecture and service dependency analysis.
- [`.instructions.md`](file:///c:/Users/lacyv/Documents/GitHub/war-of-attrition-game/.github/instructions/.instructions.md) - Frontend and backend coding standards for AI assistants.

## ⚠️ Requirements Alignment Checklist
When adding or modifying features:
1. Ensure all game rules align with `war-of-attrition-requirements.md`.
2. Keep `progress-data.json` updated when completing milestone tasks.
3. Validate that unit tests in `src/app/` match specified behavior.
